P.inherit_note: every key in 'inherit' is read from <cell run1_cell>/params.json and every key in 'inherit_run2' from <cell run2_cell>/params.json at run time (osc_l4_mass.load_params), never retyped here; the inherited eval_docs are RUN 1's eval docs and are used here ONLY as exclusions; the merged grid is written to results.json key P
P.frozen_note: both lists are COPIED by program from <cell run3_cell>/results.json keys direct_ranking and sinkcount_ranking (run 3: DIRECT = each KV head windowed alone, KL averaged over calibration docs 12/16/18; sinkcount = run 1's sinks-counted mean attention distance on the same 3 docs). No re-ranking on the fresh docs; the run checks json.dumps equality with run 3 at run time (void if not equal).
P.fresh_rule: the first n_fresh articles of wiki.valid.raw, in file order (run 1's article split), whose body has >= L tokens and whose index is not among run 1's eval docs (inherited eval_docs), run 2's calib_docs or exclude_docs (doc 13); picked by osc_l4_direct.py --pick (tokenizer only, no model) and fixed here BEFORE any scoring
P.arms_note: per budget: direct = frozen_direct_ranking[:k] (SCORED), sinkcount = frozen_sinkcount_ranking[:k] (scored comparator), random_s0..s4 and band = run 1's results.json arms (same heads), distance = run 2's results.json arm; all rerun on the fresh docs; identical head sets run once per doc
P.additivity_def: per budget: ratio = pooled fresh-doc KL of the k DIRECT heads windowed TOGETHER / sum over those k heads of each head's pooled fresh-doc KL windowed ALONE (1 head -> exactly 1); ratio_run3 = the same joint KL / sum of run 3's calibration solo KLs (mean_direct_kl). Reported, not scored.
P.rule: void if a fresh doc is among the excluded ids (or repeats), a frozen ranking differs from run 3's, the full-KV reference is not bit-identical across two passes, or an arm has the wrong k / kept; else proved iff direct agree > random max agree AND direct KL < random min KL at >= need_random_wins budgets AND direct KL < sinkcount KL at >= need_sinkcount_kl_wins budgets; else disproved
